subject: Resale billing conversion & renewal — Zephyrus Technologies
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Bose <aisha.bose@zephyrus.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@zephyrus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Paul Riddell <paul.riddell@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Resale billing conversion & renewal — Zephyrus Technologies

Hi Aisha / Zephyrus procurement,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — great to hear the expansion plans are on track. As we discussed, we think moving your account from direct invoicing to AWS Resale (Marketplace-managed billing) at your upcoming renewal will significantly simplify procurement and enable faster purchasing for downstream teams. A quick summary of benefits we will deliver:

- Single invoice via AWS (no separate Redwood invoices)
- Simplified PO renewals for multi-region seats
- Eligibility for AWS co-sell incentives and consolidated spend reporting

Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (Zephyrus_MUT_2026_v1.pdf) and our resale pricing sheet. Key asks from procurement to validate feasibility:

1) Confirmation of target renewal date (we noted 2027-01-15 as the current renewal)
2) Any internal constraints on invoicing entity (must route via AWS account: 123456789012)
3) Standard warranty/indemnity redlines procurement requires so we can pre-clear the marketplace listing

Proposed next steps (two-week timeline):
- You confirm renewal date and billing AWS account (Aisha) — by Wed 12/02
- We prepare marketplace amendment and DocuSign package (Soojin + Marcus) — by Fri 12/04
- AWS partner (Paul) validates co-sell routing and any reseller terms — by Mon 12/07

If that schedule looks okay I will circulate the updated MUT and a DocuSign for signature.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Zephyrus_MUT_2026_v1.pdf, resale_pricing_sheet.xlsx

Subject: Re: Resale billing conversion & renewal — Zephyrus Technologies

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick responses and questions from procurement:

- Renewal date: confirmed 2027-01-15 (end of current term)
- AWS account: yes, billing should be via AWS acct 123456789012 (managed by our CloudOps)

Questions:
1) Pricing impact: will the resale price be net-new or will there be any marketplace platform fee visible to us? Please confirm final customer price after resale fees.
2) Contract amendment: we need the marketplace amendment plus a redline showing any changes to data handling or SLA terms.
3) PO: attaching our current PO for the renewal (Zephyrus_PO_2026_11.pdf). We prefer to have the new process in place before the renewal effective date.

If you can send a redline + pricing breakout by Thursday I can route internally.

Best,
Aisha Bose
Head of Procurement, Zephyrus Technologies
Aisha.Bose@zephyrus.com

Subject: Resale billing conversion — pricing redline and DocuSign (Zephyrus)

Hi Aisha,

Attached: updated pricing breakout (resale_pricing_sheet.xlsx) and a marketplace amendment redline. High level: the customer-facing price is unchanged — Redwood absorbs the marketplace platform fee so Zephyrus sees the same invoice total. The resale path will appear as an AWS line item; we will provide consolidated usage reports monthly.

Key items in the redline:
- Data handling: no change to our default retention policy; we call out the marketplace flow in section 4.2
- SLA: same 99.9% availability commitment; marketplace routing adds no change to our incident process

DocuSign: I created a signing packet and sent an embedded link to Aisha for Zephyrus procurement. Copy of the link here: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-signing/abcd-efgh-2026

Next steps per timeline: once signed we will coordinate with AWS (Paul) to ensure the marketplace listing and billing flow are tested prior to your renewal on 2027-01-15. Marcus, Ben — please confirm HubSpot updated and that the DocuSign is attached to the deal.

Thanks,
Soojin
